**Subject:** Follow-Up: Urgent Onboarding Equipment Setup Request

Hi Ethan,

Could you please provide a status update on each of these items? If there are any blockers or if you need additional information from my end, don't hesitate to reach out so we can resolve them promptly.

Given the tight timeline, I appreciate your urgent attention to this matter.

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Your Contact Information]

---

Feel free to let me know if you'd like to adjust the tone, add details (such as the new hire's name or department), or modify any of the items listed.
